unlisted_practices: Use AI language translation only as an adjunct to the existing human translator and interpreter framework.
Limit AI translation to low-risk communication tasks such as appointment coordination or simple instructions.
Avoid AI translation in high-stakes contexts such as informed consent or complex management discussions.
Ensure human oversight of all AI translations to maintain clinical accuracy and patient safety.

screen.reason: Commentary/review discussing the role, risks, and guardrails (e.g. human oversight, task risk stratification) of AI for real-time language translation in regional healthcare.
